title: Adversarial training withstands replayed PGD perturbations

invariants.description: PGD L∞ ε=0.3 must still evade the undefended model; otherwise this case no longer tests anything.
At most 20% of the replayed perturbations may still evade the adversarially trained model.

On the same test samples, replayed perturbations must succeed significantly less often against the adversarially trained model (exact one-sided McNemar, α = 0.05; observed p ≤ 1.6e-08 in 7 environments).
Adversarial training must keep clean test accuracy ≥ 93%.

rationale: Non-adaptive replay: perturbations are crafted against the undefended model and re-submitted unchanged.
